# Shun Yanagisawa (柳沢 俊)

> Market infrastructure practitioner and author, based in Tokyo. His work asks one question — how do humans design trust and order within complex, uncertain systems — through two books (a professional treatise on derivatives clearing and an SF novel), bilingual (English/Japanese) essays, and Clearing Notes, ongoing writing that continues where the clearing book ends. A specialist in derivatives central clearing (OTC clearing, CCP architecture, FX prime brokerage, and Japan rates market infrastructure). Full career history and roles are on the CV page.

## Main pages

- [Home / Profile](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/): The site's central question — how humans design trust and order within complex, uncertain systems — with the author's two books, bilingual essays, and Clearing Notes.
- [Book — デリバティブ・クリアリングのすべて](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/book): Japan's first full-length professional treatise on derivatives clearing (2026).
- [Full CV](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/cv): Career history, publications, and credentials in full.
- [Speaking history](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/speaking): Panels, moderated sessions, and speaking engagements.
- [Media appearances](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/media): Press coverage and media mentions.
- [All essays index](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/essays/): The full, newest-first list of bilingual essays.

## Clearing (Japanese) — derivatives clearing, written by the author of the standard Japanese text

Short pieces placed on the chapter structure of "デリバティブ・クリアリングのすべて" (All About Derivatives Clearing, Shun Yanagisawa), recording what moved in clearing regulation after the first edition. Each piece is written from primary sources and carries its first-publication date.

- [クリアリング — 章立て / Clearing index](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/)
- [クリアリング用語集 / Clearing glossary](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/terms): A standalone glossary of derivatives clearing — Japanese-language definitions (CCP, default waterfall, initial and variation margin, cover-n, skin in the game, auto-liquidation), with English abbreviations, formal English names, category filters, official-site source links, and alternative Japanese renderings where translations differ in practice. Seeded from the back matter of "デリバティブ・クリアリングのすべて" and expanded independently as post-publication pieces introduce new terms.
- [クリアリング・ブローカーは何をファイナンスしているのか：日中マージン・コールと「時間差の信用」](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/intraday-margin-credit)
- [ダイレクト・クリアリングの制度化：与信の有無で何が変わり、何が残るのか](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/direct-clearing-credit-boundary)
- [FCMを経由しない清算では、誰が法的義務を担うのか――リテール向けダイレクト・クリアリングに残る制度上の懸念](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/direct-clearing-regulatory-gap)
- [自動ロスカットはFCMを代替できるのか――レバレッジ型ダイレクト・クリアリングの限界](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/auto-liquidation-limits)
- [日本の店頭FXは、リテール直接清算の先例になるのか――ロスカット運用と損失負担の違い](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/japan-otc-margin)
- [証拠金はどこまで予測できるのか――国際指針が求めるシミュレーターと透明性](https://www.shun-yanagisawa.com/clearing/margin-simulator-transparency)
